description:
Georgia parole decisions by year — the series GPS assembled from the
    State Board of Pardons and Paroles' own annual reports, with the metric
    definitions and the instruments note that says how they were built.

    `metric` (exact name from the `metrics` list, e.g. 'cases_considered'),
    `from_year` / `to_year` (fiscal years) filter the series. Paged: `limit`
    (default 100 rows) and `offset`.
name: get_parole_statistics
title: Get parole statistics
